newsitem.title: ITALY: UPS Italy staff to strike on March 28.
newsitem.headline: UPS Italy staff to strike on March 28.

text.p: Union members employed by United Pacel Service of America in Italy will hold an eight hour strike on March 28 in protest against 150 job cuts, union sources told Reuters.
Some 85 percent of UPS' 900 Italy staff are expected to be involved in the stoppage, they added.
The redundancies were announced by UPS Italy on March 6, and under Italian labour law, layoffs can begin 45 days later.
The company then said that it was seeking the job cuts in order to "remain competitive and cost efficient in the Italian express distribution market."
The union sources added that limited strike action is also planned by Milan-based UPS staff tomorrow, March 26, as 82 of the job losses concern the company's Milan operations.
A joint meeting between Italian union delegates and their counterparts from Spain -- also in dispute with the company - is due to take place in Milan later today, the sources said.

Further regional-based action is planned during next month, while on April 4, the unions plan to discuss an alternative proposal which could productivity while avoiding job losses, the union sources added.
On March 13, 120 UPS staff went on strike in Milan, Rome, Bari and Bolgona in protest at the job cutbacks, the sources said. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
